name: Glass Car Dash
tagline: Live speed, turn guidance, and driver reminders
description: Live phone GPS driving navigation with an OpenFreeMap phone map, OpenStreetMap destination search, automatic turn advancement and rerouting, speed, compass, road names, and a calibrated head-motion break-reminder prototype. Tap to dismiss an alert; double-tap to exit. This prototype does not confirm drowsiness.
author: Usman Kayani

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Uses your phone’s GPS to show current speed in miles per hour and support route guidance.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Uses OpenFreeMap and OpenStreetMap services to display maps, search destinations, calculate driving routes, and reroute when needed.
